content:
PagerDuty Bot: pager fired — service: inference-queue-highbacklog, severity: P1. queue_size > 95th percentile threshold for 10m (current 18.2k). incident link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-90123 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: automatic enrichment: cluster=prod-inference; autoscaler_group=shared-pool; avg_kv_cache_hit=0.12; recent_node_events=3 preemptions in last 6m.
sam (oncall): acking. I see queue backlog spike and sustained p99 latency rising. Starting triage.
Priya: on it — adding logs: 
```
2026-03-15T16:01:02Z inference-queue: enqueue_rate=4200/s dequeue_rate=310/s backlog=18234
2026-03-15T16:02:30Z autoscaler: desired=12 current=12 max=12 scaling_stalled=true reason="nodeQuota"
```
Luca: autoscaler isn't increasing because cloud quota errors during node provisioning. GKE reported insufficient regional CPU quota around 16:00 UTC.
Aisha: customer-impact snapshot: ~2% of requests returning 503s (model: gpt-3.5-open-opt), tail latency for streaming requests > 10s for affected prefixes. CS triage says a small set of PLG customers are experiencing errors.
sam (oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) try manual scale of dedicated burst pool, 2) evict non-critical batch jobs from shared-pool, 3) trigger emergency capacity request to infra (but that takes time). Going to attempt 1 & 2 now.
platform-ops: can run emergency node spin-up via reserved-pool if you want. Need `kubectl` commands or platform API.
sam (oncall): running command to scale burst nodes + bump autoscaler max: 
```
# bump pool max temporarily
kubectl patch hpa inference-worker --patch '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":40}}' -n inference
# scale a hot pool deployment
kubectl scale deploy/burst-inference --replicas=20 -n inference
```
incident-bot: pd note: PagerDuty incident PD-90123 acknowledged by sam (oncall) at 2026-03-15T16:04:12Z.
Priya: evicting batch pods on shared-pool: issuing eviction for labels job-type=batch, priority=low.
Luca: got quota error details: GCP response 403 Quota exceeded for CPUs in region-us-west1. But we have a small reserved quota in preemptible pool that can be used; need to flip pool to use preemptible nodes. Preemptible risk ok for short burst.
Aisha: inform CS: "We have a mitigation in progress — scaling burst capacity; some requests may see transient errors while queues drain. We'll update in 10m."
sam (oncall): switching burst deployment to use preemptible node selector and re-deploying. Command: 
```
kubectl set env deploy/burst-inference NODE_POOL=preemptible-burst -n inference && kubectl rollout restart deploy/burst-inference -n inference
```
platform-ops: toggled burst policy; rollouts started. Note: KV cache warmup will cause slightly higher CPU per instance for the first 30s as models coldstart.
Priya: backlog trending down: 18.2k -> 9.7k in 5m after scale actions. Dequeue rate improved to ~1.2k/s.
Luca: monitoring node provisioning events; 12 new preemptible nodes requested, 7 became ready. One preemptible instance failed to join due to image-pull on startup; restarting that pod.
Aisha: updated CS message sent to customers impacted (link to status page). No major revenue customers listed, but one enterprise integration saw increased error spikes — contacting them.
sam (oncall): still seeing p99 latency elevated. I'm going to temporarily drop model variant for background traffic to a smaller quantized variant to reduce CPU and accelerate queue draining. Applying routing override.
Priya: applying routing override: 
```
PATCH /routing/overrides inference -> model: gpt-3.5-open-opt:q4_8 -> fallback: gpt-3.5-open-opt-q4_0
```
incident-bot: automated guard triggered — routing overrides require canary flag; applied with emergency=true bypass per runbook.
Luca: note — KV cache cold prefixes responsible for much of the slowdown; prefix cache hit went from 0.6 -> 0.12 during the surge (many new prefixes). If backlog drains, we should see hit rate recover.
Priya: metrics update at 16:20Z — queue 4.1k, dequeue_rate=2.1k/s, error_rate 503->0.5%; p99 latency still ~2.4s (was 10s at peak).
Aisha: PD escalation path: PagerDuty auto-escalated to rotation-2 at 16:07Z, but sam acked, so rotation-2 didn't need to act. Incident epic created: INF-2026-03-15-queue-warmup.
platform-ops: request to infra for quota bump submitted (case INC-3344). ETA unknown (usually 2-6h). For now the preemptible burst is our primary mitigation.
sam (oncall): preparing handoff notes for next oncall at 16:35Z. Key items: backlog draining but still high traffic, autoscaler max raised to 40, burst pool at 18 replicas on preemptible, routing override in place, quota request open.
Priya: added runbook checklist to thread and attached logs.
Aisha: CS notified customers again that mitigation is successful and monitoring continues.
Luca: action items for postmortem: (1) investigate autoscaler stall detection and nodeQuota handling; (2) improve preflight quota checks to avoid stalled desired state; (3) add automated fallback to preemptible reserved pool in surge.
sam (oncall): moving to maintenance mode — will watch metrics for 30m then hand off. Please update thread with any regressions. :eyes:
incident-bot: thread marked as active incident. Last update at 2026-03-15T16:34:02Z.
